$description: Semantic colors for the dark theme. Every color a component uses is one of these, never a palette value.

surface.$description: Cards, panels and inputs: anything that sits on the page.

surface-muted.$description: Hover and pressed backgrounds, subtle fills.

border.$description: Dividers and the default outline of cards and inputs.

border-strong.$description: The outline of a control with no other visible edge (a checkbox, a text field): at least 3:1 against surface and bg, as WCAG 1.4.11 asks.

accent-fg.$description: Text and icons on the accent color.

accent-subtle.$description: A tinted background for accent highlights.

success.$description: Success text and icons, such as the Live dot.

warning.$description: Warning text and icons, such as Reconnecting.

danger-subtle.$description: An error background, such as an inline alert.
